hg 1/144 strike freedom gundam seed free.name: HG 1/144 Strike Freedom Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO Ver. (tentative)
hg 1/144 strike freedom gundam seed free.summary: New Strike Freedom kit tied to the SEED FREEDOM ZERO film (theatrical release Jan 15, 2027), with SEED Action System, two beam rifles and gradient-molded beam sabers. Japanese sources say Jan 2027; Gundam Planet lists a Feb 2027 arrival, which is likely just a North American estimate.

hg 1/144 infinite justice gundam & boost.name: HG 1/144 Infinite Justice Gundam & Booster Unit (tentative)
hg 1/144 infinite justice gundam & boost.summary: SEED FREEDOM ZERO release based on the 2020 standard retail kit, with newly tooled weapons and a booster unit.

hg 1/144 gouf ignited custom.name: HG 1/144 GOUF Ignited Custom
hg 1/144 gouf ignited custom.summary: SEED FREEDOM ZERO kit that reuses parts from the HG Gouf Ignited (Heine custom) but adds new forearms, shoulder armor, lower legs, head crest and flight pack. Retailers abroad list a May 2027 arrival.

hg 1/144 gundam zero (rg xarx-zero).name: HG 1/144 Gundam ZERO (RG XARX-ZERO)
hg 1/144 gundam zero (rg xarx-zero).summary: Lead mobile suit of the new RG XARX-ZERO anime, with Bandai's first 6-color multi-injection molding and a spine-linked articulation system. Bandai product page is live; the earlier "TBD" status is now replaced by April 2027 and 2,750 yen.

rg star gaogaigar.name: RG Star GaoGaiGar
rg star gaogaigar.summary: Space-combat form of GaoGaiGar, built on the 2022 RG kit with newly tooled Stealth Gao II, Ul-Tech Engines and Phantom Rings. Release and price were TBD when first shown on Oct 2 and have now been confirmed.

hg 1/144 gundam helix (gundam trajectory.name: HG 1/144 Gundam Helix (GUNDAM TRAJECTORY OF THE OTHER RAIL / Rogue Orbit)
hg 1/144 gundam helix (gundam trajectory.summary: Protagonist suit of the RG Project game, with deployable armor gimmicks plus a large sword and rifle. This is the standard retail version; the Earth Blue Ver. is bundled with the game and is not reported here.

hg 1/144 calice.name: HG 1/144 Calice
hg 1/144 calice.summary: Lance-wielding suit piloted by Elaine Galath in the RG Project game. Bandai's product page is live. One blog still lists a "2027" window, but Bandai-sourced reports say February 2027.

hg 1/144 bau bahlam.name: HG 1/144 Bau Bahlam
hg 1/144 bau bahlam.summary: Big Paul's mono-eye pirate suit with a chainsaw macuahuitl and a pull-cord gimmick. Bandai-sourced reports say February 2027, but some outlets still list the date as TBD 2027.

rg 1/144 gundam ground type.name: RG 1/144 Gundam Ground Type
rg 1/144 gundam ground type.summary: RG kit of the RX-79[G] Gundam Ground Type from The 08th MS Team, built on the RX-78-2 Ver.2.0 design approach. Includes a 100mm machine gun, 180mm cannon, shield, a weapon container with an extending platform, and a rock part.

hg 1/144 murasame kai (initial productio.name: HG 1/144 Murasame Kai (Initial Production Type)
hg 1/144 murasame kai (initial productio.summary: First Gunpla from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO, in new dark blue/black colors with a new beam rifle and the SEED Action System. Arrives about a month before the January 2027 film premiere.

hg 1/144 hamma-hamma.name: HG 1/144 Hamma-Hamma
hg 1/144 hamma-hamma.summary: New HG kit of the Gundam ZZ Neo Zeon mobile suit, announced at Bandai's "Latest! Gunpla Info Bureau" broadcast. It uses flexible lead wires so the detached forearms and their three-barrel beam cannons can be posed in extended positions. No physical prototype was shown.

hg 1/144 gundam virsago (after war gunda.name: HG 1/144 Gundam Virsago (After War Gundam X)
hg 1/144 gundam virsago (after war gunda.summary: All-new HG kit of the Frost Brothers' Virsago with extendable Strike Claws and an opening abdomen for the Mega Sonic Cannon. Listed under general retail releases on the official Gundam site.

hg 1/144 gundam ashtaron (after war gund.name: HG 1/144 Gundam Ashtaron (After War Gundam X)
hg 1/144 gundam ashtaron (after war gund.summary: Virsago's partner suit, with Atomic Scissors and a partial MA-mode transformation. Listed under general retail releases on the official Gundam site. One EU retailer (Zone Gunpla) estimates March 2027, but that is a retailer estimate and Bandai says November 2026.

mg 1/100 gundam liberty astray red frame.name: MG 1/100 Gundam Liberty Astray Red Frame
mg 1/100 gundam liberty astray red frame.summary: New MG kit listed under general retail Gunpla releases for October–December 2026 on the official Gundam site. The price was cut off in the search snippet and I couldn't load the page.

rg 1/144 rx-178 gundam mk-ii (keroro spe.name: RG 1/144 RX-178 Gundam Mk-II (Keroro Specification)
rg 1/144 rx-178 gundam mk-ii (keroro spe.summary: Sgt. Frog collaboration RG Gundam Mk-II, molded in green, yellow and white with Keroro decals and new Mine Yoshizaki box art. Source cites the official GUNDAM site, and the article doesn't describe it as an exclusive.
